body:
## Summary

`v0.77.0` published an image labelled `org.opencontainers.image.version=0.77.0` whose
`org.opencontainers.image.revision` was `5d127356…` — the merge commit that *triggered* the
release run — while `refs/tags/v0.77.0` resolves to `c36818b5…` (`chore: release v0.77.0`).

**Root cause:** the packaging jobs did check out the tag, but `docker/metadata-action`
derives the revision label from the workflow context (`github.sha`). On a release run that
context is frozen at the commit before the release commit the automation creates, so the
label can never match the tag.

Fixes #191.

## Changes

- `create-github-release` resolves `refs/tags/vX.Y.Z^{commit}` (peeling the annotated tag),
  asserts it equals the workspace, and exports it as the `release-commit` job output.
- Every packaging job (both image architectures, all four binary targets, the manifest job,
  the macOS lifecycle check) now checks out that **commit by SHA** and fails if
  `git rev-parse HEAD` differs. Only the release-creating job resolves the mutable tag ref.
- Image labels pin `org.opencontainers.image.revision` to the resolved commit, and each
  build inspects the pushed config to fail *before* the digest is tagged if it disagrees.
- New post-publication guard `scripts/check-release-provenance.rs`: re-resolves the annotated
  tag and compares it against the labels of **both platform manifests in both registries**,
  the checksum files, and the SLSA attestation of every downloadable archive. Wired into the
  release run (`verify-release-provenance` job) and into the daily
  `verify-releases.yml` reconciliation.
- Checksum files are generated from inside `dist/`, so they list flat names; packaging and
  the guard both run `sha256sum -c` the way a consumer does. This also fixes the report in
  [the issue comment](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/issues/191#issuecomment-5303017195):
  `sha256sum -c link-assistant-router-0.77.0-arm64.sha256` failed with
  `No such file or directory` because the entries carried a `dist/` prefix.
- `scripts/check-release-workflow.rs` asserts the new wiring statically, and the lint job now
  runs it plus the new script's unit tests on every PR.
- Docs: `docs/ci-cd/release-provenance.md`.

## How to reproduce, and the evidence

The guard reproduces the reported defect against the actually published image:

```console
$ rust-script scripts/check-release-provenance.rs --release-version 0.77.0 \
    --image konard/link-assistant-router:0.77.0
Release v0.77.0 must be built from c36818b5386486ab74b88740f683076e4015c750
Error: konard/link-assistant-router:0.77.0 (linux/amd64) has org.opencontainers.image.revision=5d12735630a9d5168e2472e54367ce59dfa86dcb, expected c36818b5386486ab74b88740f683076e4015c750
       konard/link-assistant-router:0.77.0 (linux/arm64) has ... (same)
```

The checksum defect is reproduced and the fix proven by
`experiments/issue-191/checksum-packaging.sh`: it builds a `dist/`-prefixed checksum file,
shows the consumer-side `No such file or directory`, shows the guard rejecting it, then
repeats with the new packaging and verifies `sha256sum -c` passes.

## Automated tests

- 13 unit tests in `scripts/check-release-provenance.rs` (`rust-script --test`), including a
  regression test that rejects exactly the `5d127356` / `c36818b5` mismatch from this issue,
  a test that rejects `dist/`-prefixed checksum entries, and manifest-list/label coverage.
- `scripts/check-release-workflow.rs` fails if any packaging job goes back to checking out
  the mutable tag ref, if the revision label is unpinned, or if the guard is dropped.

## v0.77.0 itself

Left as published: silently replacing an immutable artifact would change digests users may
have pinned. The next release built by this pipeline carries the correct revision label and
flat checksum files; `docs/ci-cd/release-provenance.md` documents how to verify `0.77.0`
against `c36818b5…` manually in the meantime. Note the scheduled provenance job will report
the historical mismatch until that next release is published — that is the intended signal.

Adding .gitkeep for PR creation (default mode).
This file will be removed when the task is complete.

Issue: https://github.com/link-assistant/router/issues/191

The release commit is created after the run starts, so github.sha - and with it
docker/metadata-action's default org.opencontainers.image.revision - names the
previous merge commit. v0.77.0 therefore shipped an image labelled 0.77.0 whose
revision pointed at 5d127356 instead of the tag commit c36818b5.

- create-github-release resolves refs/tags/vX.Y.Z^{commit} and exports it
- every packaging job checks out that commit by SHA and asserts HEAD matches
- image labels pin the revision, verified on the pushed digest before tagging
- scripts/check-release-provenance.rs re-resolves the tag after publication and
  compares it with both platform manifests, checksum files and attestations
- checksum files list flat asset names so sha256sum -c works after download

Fixes #191
commits.messageHeadline: fix: build and label release artifacts from the release tag commit

commits.messageBody:
metadata-action always emits org.opencontainers.image.revision=github.sha.
Adding a second value for the same key leaves the winner to label ordering, so
strip the generated entry and append the resolved tag commit instead.
commits.messageHeadline: fix: pin the image revision label deterministically
test: expect provenance job's registry logins and flat checksum digests

title: fix: build and label every release artifact from the release tag commit
